title: Segment length under force
description: Essential: Correctly states Δy = (F/(kL₀))Δℓ for F > 0, or equivalent max expression.

title: Work to stretch segment
description: Important: Derives or states ΔW = (kL₀/(2Δℓ))(Δy² - Δℓ²) from integrating force.

title: Equilibrium total length
description: Essential: Gives final expression H = (L₀/2)(α + 1/α) from integration of stretched elements.

title: Collapse time expression
description: Essential: Provides symbolic answer t_c = √[ (L₀/(3gα)) (1-α)³ ] using center-of-mass free fall.

title: Numerical collapse time
description: Essential: Computes t_c ≈ 0.245 s correctly from given parameters.

title: Velocity constants A and B
description: Important: Identifies A = 2g/(3α) and B = (1/(3α) - 1)gL₀ from energy or dynamics.

title: Minimum speed expression
description: Important: States v_min = (1-α)√(AαL₀ + B) using momentum or tip condition.

title: Energy loss Q
description: Essential: Gives Q = (MgL₀(1-α)²(2α+1))/(6α) from elastic energy difference.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Misplaces α definition (α = kL₀/(Mg)) or uses inverted ratio, leading to wrong signs or magnitudes.

title: Missing unstretched limit
description: Pitfall: Omits max condition or lower bound Δy ≥ Δℓ in part A.1, or mishandles l₀ = αL₀ in integrations.
